newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed in dull trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Monday are expected to be mixed and trading dull, brokers said.
"The sentiment of the investors is not good as the new budget for 1997/98 (July-June) did not spell out anything especially encouraging for them," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
The DSE all-share price index dropped 9.32 points or 0.80 percent at 1,148.11 on a turnover of 42 million taka on Sunday.
